    The BGRS Figure 16 cleaving source #

    The literal source is the affine D̃₅ tree with two central vertices and two leaves at each center. The one-parameter family below puts k² at both centers, k at each leaf, the identity on the central edge, and the four lines

    • e₀,
    • e₁,
    • e₀ + e₁, and
    • e₀ + c e₁.

    Naturality forces every family morphism to be scalar on both centers, and its scalar satisfies c r = d r. Thus the family is indecomposable and separates parameters. A Hom-bifunctor retraction of an ambient Figure-16 diagram then contradicts representation-finiteness by the generic cleaving transfer.
